## Rules

- [Milk drinks have milk](../rules.md#rule-milk-drinks-have-milk) (inherited from [MilkDrink](c-milk-drink.md), MUST): A MilkDrink MUST contain a milk ingredient. Source: [Vertex Coffee house guide > Milk drinks, line 5](../sources.md#loc-vertex-coffee-house-guide-bdsph9).
  > Every milk drink must contain milk or cream.
